hooks.command: [ -z "$NUDGEWHEN_IDLE_DIR" ] || { umask 077; t="$NUDGEWHEN_IDLE_DIR/.nudgewhen-idle.$$"; cat > "$t" && ! grep -q '"stop_hook_active" *: *true' "$t" && id=$(sed 's/\[[^]]*\]//g' "$t" | grep -o '"session_id" *: *"[A-Za-z0-9_-][A-Za-z0-9_-]*"' | head -n 1 | sed 's/^.*: *"\(.*\)"$/\1/') && [ -n "$id" ] && mv "$t" "$NUDGEWHEN_IDLE_DIR/nudgewhen-idle-$id.json" || rm -f "$t"; }; exit 0
